Parameters of the stochastic ENSO model

Source: R/enso-model.R
aci_enso_parameters.Rd

Builds the parameter list of the ENSO model, with the defaults of the reference implementation. Most parameters are derived from a smaller set of physical ones, so they are computed here rather than left for a caller to keep consistent.

Usage

aci_enso_parameters(
  factor = 0.65,
  b_0 = 2.5,
  mu = 0.5,
  d_tau = 2,
  lambda = 2/60,
  m = 2
)

Arguments

factor

Numeric scalar. The diversity-modulating parameter that governs how many extreme eastern-Pacific events the model produces.

b_0

Numeric scalar. High-end estimate of the thermocline tilt.

mu

Numeric scalar. Relative coupling coefficient.

d_tau

Numeric scalar. Damping of the wind burst.

lambda

Numeric scalar. Damping of the Walker circulation.

m

Numeric scalar. Target equilibrium mean of the Walker circulation.

Value

A named list of the model's parameters, derived and primitive.

References

Andreou, M., Chen, N. and Bollt, E. (2026). Assimilative causal inference. Nature Communications, 17, 1854. doi:10.1038/s41467-026-68568-0

See also

aci_enso_components(), aci_enso_model()

Examples

str(aci_enso_parameters())
